unit.why: A first-person memorate by the author (R. Yitzhak Eizik of Komarno, from Megillat Setarim) about his theurgic acts on Rosh Hashana 5606, a night vision of the ministering angels of Russia and Edom, and the annulment of decrees.

stories.start_quote: עוד שם בראש השנה תר"ו ביום א׳
stories.summary_en: On Rosh Hashana 1845 the tzaddik works mystical acts for the Jews of Russia and subdues its heavenly prince. At night the prince threatens him with a drawn sword and the tzaddik promises to let him be. The prince of Edom then promises to make no evil decree, the tzaddik blesses him with the blessing said over a king, and on waking all decrees against the Jews are annulled.
